title.suggested: Christol answers Tom Allen's offer to back Bauer

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Andre Christol answered Tom Allen's offer to back wrestler Theobaud Bauer by asking to meet in Chicago, while Allen, who had brought Bauer from Boston, gave a sparring exhibition in Louisville.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday, March 12, 1876. Christol's letter is dated 'March 10, 1875' in print, evidently a misprint for 1876.

facts.fact: Allen went from St. Louis to Louisville and gave a sparring exhibition there, assisted by his trainers Ned Donnelly and Jack Madden and local boxers, returning the next morning
Allen brought champion wrestler Theobaud Bauer from Boston to St. Louis, on a Chicago friend's word that Andre Christol would wrestle him there

Allen offered to back Bauer to wrestle Andre Christol; Christol replied by letter that he would meet Bauer only in Chicago, then Chicago backers telegraphed Allen's offering to back Christol to wrestle in St. Louis
